CMP.pf.products[0].why|/0: One resin for priming, scratch coats, mortars (5–30 mm) and epoxy screeds (11–150 mm): fewer products on site, one mixing rule (1 : 1 with sand for the scratch coat, approx. 3 : 25 for the screed).
CMP.pf.products[0].why|/1: Published tensile adhesion ≥ 1.5 N/mm² on concrete that is dry to matt damp; the comparable primers state a dry substrate (≤ 4 % moisture, no rising damp) as the condition.
CMP.pf.products[0].why|/2: Flexural strength approx. 35 N/mm² (DIN EN 196-1) against approx. 15 N/mm² published for the Sikafloor-156 mortar — the figures are not from identical test bodies and are quoted as printed.
CMP.pf.products[0].why|/3: Pot life approx. 35 minutes at a simple 100 : 50 mixing ratio.
CMP.pf.products[1].type|: solvent-free epoxy barrier primer for damp substrates (negative pressing water up to 3 bar)
CMP.pf.products[1].why|/0: A two-component resin primer — no cement component to batch (Sikafloor-81 EpoCem and Triblock P are three-component epoxy-cement systems), mixed in one step at 100 : 52.
CMP.pf.products[1].why|/1: Published as watertight against negative pressing water up to 3 bar; the comparable products are described for damp or green concrete without a stated pressure rating.
CMP.pf.products[1].why|/2: Overcoating window of 12 hours to 5 days gives the schedule room; the following resin layers bond to the sanded second coat.
CMP.pf.products[1].why|/3: The same resin serves as scratch coat and mortar binder (1 : 1 and approx. 3 : 25 with quartz sand).
CMP.pf.products[2].type|: universal epoxy industrial floor coating, roller coat to self-smoothing thick coat
CMP.pf.products[2].why|/0: Published flexural strength approx. 44 N/mm² and compressive approx. 70 N/mm² — the filled comparison values are approx. 20 / 53 N/mm² (Sikafloor-264 N) and 28 / 67 N/mm² (Mapefloor I 300 SL); test bodies differ and the figures are quoted as printed.
CMP.pf.products[2].why|/1: Overcoatable after 12 hours (24 hours for Sikafloor-264 N at +20 °C): two coats in two days.
CMP.pf.products[2].why|/2: Reaction to fire Bfl-s1 and slip resistance R11 to R12 with quartz sand are published in the technical data sheet.
CMP.pf.products[2].why|/3: One product from the thin roller coat (0.4–0.5 kg/m²) to the self-smoothing thick coat (2 : 1 with quartz sand) and the broadcast slip system.
CMP.pf.products[3].type|: water-emulsified epoxy concrete sealer, primer and seal in one
CMP.pf.products[3].why|/0: Primer and seal from one container: diluted with 8–10 % water as the primer, undiluted as the pigmented, vapour-permeable seal — a garage or cellar floor in two days.
CMP.pf.products[3].why|/1: Published tensile adhesion ≥ 2.8 N/mm² on dry concrete; the comparable water-based seals publish > 2.0 MPa (TC 442 W) or no adhesion value.
CMP.pf.products[3].why|/2: Slip resistance R10 with ASO-Antislide stirred into the last coat, by test report.
CMP.pf.products[3].why|/3: Fills with ASO-FF for pinholes and with quartz sand (1 : 0.5) as a levelling coat up to 2 mm — the comparison products are seal coats only.
CMP.pf.products[4].type|: solvent-free epoxy sealing coating for wastewater plants, chemically resistant
CMP.pf.products[4].why|/0: An elastic epoxy (Shore A approx. 80) for the sealing of tanks, channels and pits — it follows the small movements of the concrete; the comparable epoxy coatings are rigid (Shore D 80–82).
CMP.pf.products[4].why|/1: The published chemical-resistance list names the media of the wastewater plant by name (acids, alkalis, fuels, oils, solvents, formaldehyde); Sikafloor-381 and Mapecoat I 24 refer to lists on request.
CMP.pf.products[4].why|/2: Pot life 45–55 minutes at +20 °C with a 7 : 1 ratio — the longest working time of the four.
CMP.pf.products[4].why|/3: Applied directly on blasted steel without a primer; on concrete over ASODUR-SG3-thix.
CMP.pf.products[5].type|: one-component moisture-curing polyurethane joint sealant for floor joints
CMP.pf.products[5].why|/0: Shore A approx. 40 with 25 % permissible deformation: firm enough for the wheels of forklifts and trolleys, elastic enough for the field and wall joints of the slab.
CMP.pf.products[5].why|/1: Service temperature −40 to +80 °C, published; Sikaflex PRO-3 is published to +70 °C.
CMP.pf.products[5].why|/2: Tear resistance approx. 9.0 N/mm² and recovery > 90 % — the joint returns after the load.
CMP.pf.products[5].why|/3: Edges chamfered under vehicle traffic and a width : depth of 1 : 0.8 are specified in the technical data sheet, so the detail is designed, not improvised.
CMP.inj.subtitle|: AQUAFIN-P4, AQUAFIN-P1 and ASODUR-IH against the comparable injection resins of Sika, Master Builders Solutions, Mapei and Fosroc
CMP.inj.products[0].type|: two-component polyurethane injection resin, crack-bridging, soft elastic (permanent seal)
CMP.inj.products[0].charts[1].title|: Shore A hardness of the cured resin
CMP.inj.products[0].why|/0: A true two-component, non-foaming elastic resin (1 : 1 by volume): the seal is a solid, soft-elastic body of resin in the crack — the single-component competitors (SikaInject-232, Nitofill PU150) foam with water and seal with a foam.
CMP.inj.products[0].why|/1: Shore A approx. 47 after 21 hours and final curing in approx. 5 hours at +20 °C: the component can be loaded the same day.
CMP.inj.products[0].why|/2: Viscosity approx. 125 mPa·s reaches the fine branches of the crack; comparable in class to Sika Injection-201 CE (~100 mPa·s) and well below the 300–650 cps of the single-component resins.
CMP.inj.products[0].why|/3: Consumption approx. 1.1 kg per litre of voids is published, so the quantity can be estimated from the crack volume.
CMP.inj.products[1].type|: one-component polyurethane injection foam for water-conducting cracks (temporary stop)
CMP.inj.products[1].why|/0: One component, no accelerator to dose: the resin reacts with the water in the crack itself — SikaInject-233 and Nitofill PU130 need 2–10 % accelerator for their reaction times, Sika Injection-101 RC is a two-component resin.
CMP.inj.products[1].why|/1: Foams to up to approx. 40 times its volume, at the top of the range published by the comparable products (20–45×).
CMP.inj.products[1].why|/2: Designed as the first step of the two-step injection: the foam stops the water, AQUAFIN-P4 then seals the crack permanently through the same packers.
CMP.inj.products[2].type|: two-component epoxy injection resin for the force-locking bonding of cracks
CMP.inj.products[2].why|/0: A solvent-free epoxy injection resin of the same family as the AQUAFIN injection resins: the packers, pumps and the surface seal (ASODUR-EKF) are shared across the system.
CMP.inj.products[2].why|/1: CE-marked to DIN EN 1504-5 for the force-locking filling of cracks — the structural repair, where the PU resins seal.
CMP.inj.products[2].why|/2: Values of the comparable products are quoted from their sheets; the current ASODUR-IH technical data sheet is the reference for the project.
CMP.cr.subtitle|: The ASOCRET restoration system against the comparable products of Sika, Mapei, Master Builders Solutions (SikaEmaco) and Fosroc
CMP.cr.products[0].type|: PCC repair mortar, EN 1504-3 class R4, breakouts 5–40 mm
CMP.cr.products[0].why|/0: Class R4 with approx. 60 N/mm² at 28 days and ≥ 2 N/mm² adhesion — on par with the R4 mortars of the comparison.
CMP.cr.products[0].why|/1: E-modulus approx. 20 GPa, the lowest of the four published values (26 GPa Mapegrout Thixotropic, ≥ 29 GPa SikaEmaco S 5400): a stiffness closer to the parent concrete, so the repair follows the structure rather than fighting it.
CMP.cr.products[0].why|/2: Starts at 5 mm (Sika MonoTop-4012 from 6 mm, Mapegrout Thixotropic from 10 mm) — thin breakouts are repaired with the same mortar.
CMP.cr.products[0].why|/3: Consumption approx. 1.8 kg/m² per mm against approx. 1.9 kg for the comparable mortars.
CMP.cr.products[1].type|: fine smoothing mortar, EN 1504-3 class R2, 1–6 mm
CMP.cr.products[1].why|/0: Compressive strength approx. 40 N/mm² at 28 days — the highest of the published values of the fine mortars compared (20–34 N/mm²).
CMP.cr.products[1].why|/1: Up to 6 mm in one step on walls and floors; Sika MonoTop-3020 and Planitop 200 stop at 5 and 3 mm per coat.
CMP.cr.products[1].why|/2: Pot life approx. 60 minutes for large areas of fine smoothing.
CMP.cr.products[1].why|/3: Classified to EN 1504-3 (R2) like the repair mortar it closes — one standard across the system; Planitop 200 is classified as an EN 1504-2 coating.
CMP.cr.products[2].type|: one-component cementitious corrosion protection (EN 1504-7) and bond coat
CMP.cr.products[2].why|/0: One bag for three jobs — corrosion protection of the reinforcement, bond coat and contact slurry — with the water addition as the only variable; SikaTop Armatec-110 EpoCem is a three-component epoxy-cement kit, Mapefer 1K Zero a rebar coating without a stated bond-coat consumption.
CMP.cr.products[2].why|/1: One-component and cement-based: brushed into the matt damp substrate, the repair mortar follows wet in wet.
CMP.cr.products[2].why|/2: Published consumption per mm for both uses (approx. 1.5 and 1.6 kg/m²), so the quantities of the system can be calculated.
CMP.cr.products[2].why|/3: Flexible (polymer-modified) — the system is designed for the ASOCRET-BIS mortars on top; the values of the comparable products are quoted as published.
CMP.cr.products[3].type|: crystalline repair mortar for water-bearing cracks and coves
CMP.cr.products[3].why|/0: A crystalline mortar: the active ingredients grow into the capillaries of the concrete around the chase and the cove — the comparable products are plugging binders (Lamposilex, SikaSet Waterplug) or a rigid slurry (SikaTop Seal-107), not crystalline.
CMP.cr.products[3].why|/1: Working time approx. 30 minutes for the chase and the cove in one pass; the rapid plugs set within 1–3 minutes and are meant for the running leak only (in the SCHOMBURG system FIX-20-T takes that role).
CMP.cr.products[3].why|/2: Published consumption per metre of chase and cove (approx. 1.3 kg/m) — the quantity follows the drawing.
CMP.cr.products[3].why|/3: AQUAFIN-IC follows wet in wet after 1–3 hours: one crystalline system from the crack to the surface.
CMP.wp.subtitle|: The AQUAFIN mineral waterproofing products against the comparable products of Sika, Mapei, Master Builders Solutions (SikaTop / Sikalastic) and Fosroc (Vandex)
CMP.wp.products[0].why|/0: Positive and negative pressure values are both published (1 bar / 0.75 bar) with the test regulations (PG MDS/FPD, WTA 4-6); of the comparable rigid slurries only Vandex BB75-Z publishes a positive value and none a negative one.
CMP.wp.products[0].why|/1: One component — water is the only addition (SikaTop Seal-107 is a two-component kit).
CMP.wp.products[0].why|/2: Pot life approx. 60 minutes and overcoating after approx. 6 hours; the system build-up is given in kg/m² for the water load, so the quantity follows the exposure class.
CMP.wp.products[0].why|/3: Tested for the German waterproofing standards DIN 18533 / 18535 that the guide is built on.
CMP.wp.products[1].type|: two-component flexible crack-bridging mineral waterproofing slurry
CMP.wp.products[1].why|/0: Elongation approx. 192 % (ASTM D412) against approx. 40 % published for SikaTop-588 Seal on the same method: the slurry stretches with the crack instead of tearing.
CMP.wp.products[1].why|/1: Crack bridging published on three methods (EN 14891 > 0.75 mm, PG MDS/FPD 0.4 mm, ASTM C836 > 2.6 mm) — the figures are comparable method by method; Vandex BB75E-Z publishes < 0.8 mm, Sikalastic-152 ~1.2 mm (EN 1062-7).
CMP.wp.products[1].why|/2: Both pressure directions published: 2.5 bar positive and 0.75 bar negative (WTA 4-6); the comparison products publish either a positive value or none.
CMP.wp.products[1].why|/3: CO₂ diffusion Sd > 200 m at 2 mm: protects the reinforcement against carbonation as well as the structure against water.
CMP.wp.products[2].type|: rapid two-component flexible thick-layer cementitious waterproofing (bitumen-free)
